description: Generated zebra puzzle (5 houses × 3 attributes, 12 clues, unique solution verified by brute force).

input.message:
5 houses stand in a row, numbered 1 to 5 from left to right.
Each house has a different colour (red, green, blue, amber, violet), one resident (Ada, Bruno, Chen, Dara, Eli), and each resident drinks a different beverage (tea, coffee, milk, juice, water).

Clues:
1. the violet house is in house 3.
2. Eli lives in NOT the amber house.
3. Eli lives in NOT the violet house.
4. the green house is in house 4.
5. Bruno drinks NOT the milk drinker.
6. the amber house belongs to the tea drinker.
7. the amber house is home to NOT Ada.
8. the water drinker is somewhere to the right of the blue house.
9. Dara is in house 1.
10. the water drinker is in house 2.
11. the juice drinker is in house 3.
12. Bruno is in house 4.

This puzzle has exactly one solution. Work out who lives in each house, its colour, and their drink.

End your answer with one line per house in EXACTLY this format:
House 1: <name> - <colour> - <drink>
House 2: <name> - <colour> - <drink>
(and so on)
